instruction.name: vbitsel.v
instruction.description: Compute bitwise selection: for each bit position, if the bit in `c` equals to one, copy the bit from `b` to `dst`, otherwise copy from `a`.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; vreplgr2vr.b $vr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; vreplgr2vr.b $vr3, $r4

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
